name.text: Exercise Q1 Alternating interior angles and Corresponding angles

questiontext.text:
Determine the value of \(x\) for both angles shown in the diagram below.

  1. [[jsxgraph]] var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard('jxgbox', { boundingbox: [-1, 7, 8, -1], axis: false, showCopyright: false, showNavigation: false, keepAspectRatio: true }); // Define points for parallel lines var A = board.create('point', [0,5], {name:'A', size:2, fixed:true, visible:false}); var B = board.create('point', [7,5], {name:'B', size:2, fixed:true, visible:false}); var C = board.create('point', [0,2], {name:'C', size:2, fixed:true, visible:false}); var D = board.create('point', [7,2], {name:'D', size:2, fixed:true, visible:false}); // Draw parallel lines AB and CD var lineAB = board.create('line', [A, B], {straightFirst:false, straightLast:false, strokeWidth:2}); var lineCD = board.create('line', [C, D], {straightFirst:false, straightLast:false, strokeWidth:2}); // Define points for transversal var X = board.create('point', [1,0], {name:'X', size:2, fixed:true, visible:false}); var Y = board.create('point', [4,6], {name:'Y', size:2, fixed:true, visible:false}); // Draw transversal XY var transversal = board.create('line', [X,Y], {straightFirst:false, straightLast:false, strokeWidth:2, dash:2}); // Intersection points of transversal with parallel lines var O1 = board.create('intersection', [lineAB, transversal, 0], {name:'O₁', size:2}); var O2 = board.create('intersection', [lineCD, transversal, 0], {name:'O₂', size:2}); // Highlight alternate angle at O1 board.create('angle', [A,O1,O2], { radius: 0.6, name: '{#angle_alt#}°', type: 'sector', fillColor: 'lightblue', fillOpacity: 0.6, strokeColor: 'blue', strokeWidth: 1 }); // Highlight alternate angle at O2 board.create('angle', [D,O2,O1], { radius: 0.6, name: ' x', type: 'sector', fillColor: 'lightblue', fillOpacity: 0.6, strokeColor: 'blue', strokeWidth: 1 }); [[/jsxgraph]]

    Write your answer here \(x = \) [[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]] [[feedback:prt1]] \(^\circ\)

    Give a reason for your answer. [[input:ans4]] [[validation:ans4]] [[feedback:prt4]]

  2. [[jsxgraph]] var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard('jxgbox', { boundingbox: [-1, 7, 8, -1], axis: false, showCopyright: false, showNavigation: false, keepAspectRatio: true }); // Define points for parallel lines var A = board.create('point', [0,5], {name:'A', size:2, fixed:true, visible:false}); var B = board.create('point', [7,5], {name:'B', size:2, fixed:true, visible:false}); var C = board.create('point', [0,2], {name:'C', size:2, fixed:true, visible:false}); var D = board.create('point', [7,2], {name:'D', size:2, fixed:true, visible:false}); // Draw parallel lines AB and CD var lineAB = board.create('line', [A, B], {straightFirst:false, straightLast:false, strokeWidth:2}); var lineCD = board.create('line', [C, D], {straightFirst:false, straightLast:false, strokeWidth:2}); // Define points for transversal var X = board.create('point', [1,0], {name:'X', size:2, fixed:true, visible:false}); var Y = board.create('point', [4,6], {name:'Y', size:2, fixed:true, visible:false}); // Draw transversal XY var transversal = board.create('line', [X,Y], {straightFirst:false, straightLast:false, strokeWidth:2, dash:2}); // Intersection points of transversal with parallel lines var O1 = board.create('intersection', [lineAB, transversal, 0], {name:'O₁', size:2}); var O2 = board.create('intersection', [lineCD, transversal, 0], {name:'O₂', size:2}); // Highlight alternate angle at O1 board.create('angle', [O2, O1,B], { radius: 0.6, name: 'x', type: 'sector', fillColor: 'lightblue', fillOpacity: 0.6, strokeColor: 'blue', strokeWidth: 1 }); // Highlight alternate angle at O2 board.create('angle', [X,O2,D], { radius: 0.6, name: '{#angle_corresponding#}°', type: 'sector', fillColor: 'lightblue', fillOpacity: 0.6, strokeColor: 'blue', strokeWidth: 1 }); [[/jsxgraph]]
